messages.content: I want to drive from Detroit to Nashville. What is the best route?
The most popular route is I-75 South to I-24 West — about 9 hours without stops. Would you like suggestions for stops along the way?
Yes please. We like hiking and good food.
Great choices. I would suggest stopping in Lexington KY for lunch and hitting the Red River Gorge area for a short hike. Then continue south into Nashville for dinner on Broadway.
How long is the Red River Gorge detour?
About 45 minutes off I-75. Worth every minute. The Natural Bridge trail is under 2 miles and has stunning views.

agent_notes:
This route avoids toll roads on I-75.
Gas stops recommended in Corbin KY and Cookeville TN.
Nashville parking is easiest in the 2nd Ave garage on weekends.

feedback.comment: Super helpful, exactly what I needed.
